title: Travelio: 471.4K accounts breached
summary: In November 2021, the Indonesian real estate website Travelio suffered a data breach that exposed over 470k customer accounts. The data included email addresses, names, password hashes, phone numbers and for some accounts, dates of birth, physical address and Facebook auth tokens.
